description: Comptage vélo - Données compteurs à Issy-les-Moulineaux is a dataset listed in Issy-les-moulineaux open data portal, an open data portal (Opendatasoft) of a city, published or maintained by Direction de la Voirie et des Déplacements - Ville de Paris. Ces données issues de compteurs vélo permanents permettent d'évaluer le développement de la pratique cycliste. Visualisation: Ce jeu de données présente l’ensemble des comptages vélo horaires sur 13 mois glissants (J-13 mois), mis à jour à J-1. Les compteurs sont situés sur des pistes cyclables et dans certains couloirs bus ouverts aux vélos. Coverage: Issy-les-Moulineaux. The portal files it under Transports, Déplacements. Its keywords are vélo, comptage vélo, Myanatol, Ville durable. The portal shows 18,850 records. The portal flags it as a time series. It carries geographic features and can be exported as GeoJSON, KML or Shapefile. The portal shows 2026-09-28 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is ODbL-1.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support cycling and walking network and demand studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ods-data-issy-com-portal.
